errors.serverUnreachable: The server can't be reached. Check the address and port, and that you are online.
errors.localNetwork: The server can't be reached. If it is on your local network, allow Mumcord under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network, then try again.
errors.serverTooOld: The server doesn't accept this version of Mumcord. Check for a Mumcord update, or ask the server owner.
errors.wrongPassword: The server password is wrong. Edit the server and enter the right password.
errors.nameInUse: Your name is already in use or registered to someone else on this server. Edit the server and choose another name.
errors.certificateRejected: The certificate check failed: either the server's certificate was not trusted, or the server did not accept your identity. Try again, or ask the server owner.
errors.certificateChanged: The server's certificate has changed and was not trusted. Only trust it after the server owner confirms the change.
errors.invalidAddress: The server address isn't valid. Edit the server to fix it.
errors.secureStorage: Your system's secure storage isn't available, so the server password could not be read or saved. Unlock it and try again.
errors.notFound: This server is no longer saved.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.serverLimit: You're already connected to the maximum of {{limit}} servers. Disconnect a server, or raise the limit in Settings → Servers.
errors.serverLimitUnknown: You're already connected to the maximum number of servers. Disconnect a server, or raise the limit in Settings → Servers.
errors.alwaysConnectLimit: Only {{limit}} servers can be set to “Always connect at start”, the same as the limit of connected servers. Turn it off for another server, or raise the limit in Settings → Servers.
errors.alwaysConnectLimitUnknown: No more servers can be set to “Always connect at start” than the limit of connected servers. Turn it off for another server, or raise the limit in Settings → Servers.

remove.title: Remove {{server}}?
